item.title: Illegal parking, 23rd November
item.description:
Dear Council Team, I would like to make a formal complaint regarding a vehicle that has been parked inconsiderately outside my property. As shown in the attached photograph, the vehicle has been parked across the grass area directly outside my house, obstructing the space in front of my property. This is unacceptable, as the grass area is not intended for vehicle parking. It also risks damaging the grass and creates an obstruction for residents. I am concerned that allowing this type of parking to continue will encourage other drivers to do the same. I would appreciate it if the council could investigate this matter and take appropriate action to prevent it from happening again. I have attached photographic evidence for your reference.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Wellington Avenue, Edmonton

item.title: Outside No 13, 22nd November
item.description:
Urgent Report – Pothole Causing Significant Vibrations and Potential Structural Damage to Residential Property This pothole has been present for several months, following what I understand to have been works carried out by Thames Water in the area (not only once and after water was running for multiple days). Since its appearance, very often when a heavy vehicle or bus passes over the affected section of the road, the resulting vibrations are so severe that the entire property visibly and physically shakes. This is causing significant distress and concern for my family. I am regularly being woken during the night by the shaking, which is extremely alarming and feels comparable to an earthquake. More concerningly, multiple cracks have now appeared in different areas of the flat, raising serious concerns about potential damage to the property. The situation has reached a point where I am genuinely worried about the safety of my family and the possibility of further structural damage if these vibrations are allowed to continue. I am therefore requesting that Camden Council treats this matter as an urgent health and safety concern and arranges an immediate inspection of the road surface and surrounding area. I would also ask that the relevant department investigates whether the previous Thames Water works may have contributed to the problem and assesses the impact of the ongoing vibrations on neighbouring residential properties. The pothole needs to be repaired as a matter of urgency to prevent further disruption, damage and potential risk to residents. I would appreciate an urgent response confirming what action will be taken and when an inspection and necessary repairs can be arranged.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 12, Cleve Road, South Hampstead, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
